sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed for the fuel gas strainer every 
six months as indicated by M6 in the title black or the periodic fuel gas 
analysis report refers to abnormal or strange imparities or liquid contained 
with the fuel gas came from the purchasers lines

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Aly Mohamed Fahmy, tested by eng. Amr Gad, 
accepted by eng. Sawsan El lithe 
general manager, revised by eng. 
Zakaria El-Shahat 
EDEPC MPIS coordinator and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa quality insurance head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued,

The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, eye glass
Insure that no any spark source or lighting cigarettes exist
Insure that the inlet valve firmly closed
Insure that the valve is open and plug aid the vented gas stopped
If the strainer screen must be cleaned by solvent detergent

tightening

temperature

items:
During operation clean 
by opening blow - down valve, (with exposing the flat mirror) from dirt, scale, 
etc

During shut if dirt, 
scale, other strange things it must be close the inlet valve and the line after 
the inlet valve vented to atmosphere, and open the blow - down valve

Loose the strainer 
flange bolts

Bring out the strainer and 
clean with the suitable solvent cleaner

Reassemble the strainer 
and retighten the flange and flange bolts

Close the blow - down 
valve

Open the inlet gas valve 
slightly until the line after the inlet valve and its priming and pressurized

Close the vent valve and 
its plug

Complete to open the 
inlet fuel gas valve

tightening

tightening

devices
